head: e3d92e096f47e6f02590bf5fe8b34ca0899ab618
action: Replace detector-box-normalized correspondence by generic Census image registration and use cached reference terminal-image response; preserve existing current response, frozen head weights, 7 geometry features, source cells, and threshold0.
question: Can one implementable label-free coordinate+reference-history repair rescue832 without losing own70/1102 or admitting foreign574 on all5 archived cases?
hypothesis: Full-template raw-image Census registration can estimate a usable world translation outside the old residual search grid; combined with held reference response it may repair the measured coupled failure.
cases: All5 archived cases from frozen stage protocol; IDs/labels are output/evaluation metadata only. register_translation accepts new generic case geometry/images, no old_id or GT.

algorithm.grayscale: Existing native raw-frame PNG decoded by cv2.IMREAD_GRAYSCALE; no rescaling.
algorithm.descriptor: 5x5 Census:24 strict neighbor<center comparisons; 24bit Hamming per source pixel.
algorithm.source_pixels: All integer pixel centers inside archived reference_box, clipped to reference_crop with2px descriptor margin and image borders; ceil lower and floor upper inclusive.
algorithm.domain: ALL integer dx,dy keeping complete source pixel template and2px descriptor neighborhoods inside current_crop/image, AND all original full-template source map cells inside current eye convex hull; no arbitrary radius and no GT.
algorithm.objective: Lexicographic median Hamming (fixed50th percentile), total Hamming, squared distance to detector-center translation,dx,dy. Median averages middle two for even count; no trimming/adaptive parameter/search after outcomes.
algorithm.mapping: query=(source_world+estimated_translation-current_crop_min)*eye_size/current_crop_size. No detector-affine rescaling or old residual offset added after registration.
algorithm.failure: Empty template/no feasible full-support shift => registration not ready; no silently invented translation or acceptance.

acceptance: Integrity and identity: all source hashes unchanged; original index channels reproduce saved original within1e-9.

Independent audit enumerates the ENTIRE same shift domain, direct Boolean Census rather than packed bit/popcount algorithm, every cost tuple and deterministic argmin; scalar channel/head and SciPy interpolation error<1e-9.

Primary useful repair: Census+referenceheld nativeC34 accepts own832, preserves acceptedown70/1102, and does not accept foreign574; report own232 separately and every all5 control. Cases exactly five.
Primary interaction evidence: compare all2x2 conditions; coordinate-only and held-only failures cannot be hidden. No head/threshold changes or registration tuning after outcomes.
If primary fails, retain implementation+exact errors and provide explicit defer/continue recommendation rather than promoting this universal repair. No full tracker or HOTA claim.

literature.title: Non-parametric Local Transforms for Computing Visual Correspondence
literature.role: Census local intensity ordering and Hamming correspondence; our5x5 whole-template median aggregation and bounds are fixed engineering choices, not results promised by the paper.

execution.owner: Parent scheduler only; worker requires GO.json approved:true; no manual duplicate.

limits: Five reused engineering cases; operational coordinate rule sees no GT, but effect is not generalized or deployed. Core maps held under synthetic input history reused from prior verified calculation; online full-module history path not measured here. Census can align a different visible surface under occlusion; no physical truth guaranteed.
